recognize_zh: 極低倍下淋巴結實質被瀰漫而均一的浸潤佔滿，看不到正常濾泡結構，下方被膜下方有較深染的淋巴球帶；解析度有限，只能看出結構破壞的整體樣貌。
features: Diffuse, fairly monotonous-appearing effacement of lymph node parenchyma at very low power
Thin capsule at the bottom with a darker band of small lymphocytes beneath it
Vague pale areas within the infiltrate; cytologic and vascular detail not resolvable
describe_en: Very low-power section of a lymph node shows diffuse effacement of the parenchyma by a cellular infiltrate without identifiable reactive follicles. A thin capsule is present at the bottom, with a subjacent darker band of small lymphocytes. Resolution is insufficient to evaluate sinus patency, vascular proliferation, or cytologic features. Findings are compatible with a diffuse nodal lymphoma and, in context, with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; higher-power histology and immunophenotyping are required.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS also effaces the node but lacks the TFH phenotype, arborizing HEVs, and expanded perivascular FDC meshworks of AITL.
DLBCL is composed of sheets of large CD20-positive B cells rather than a polymorphous infiltrate of TFH-phenotype T cells.
Reactive nodes preserve follicles and sinuses on low power, which are not seen here.
